Requirement: [E]nable users to request and receive coverage requirements.

Support the capability to initiate and exchange information as a “CRD Client” to enable the identification of coverage requirements according to at least one of the versions of the implementation specification adopted in § 170.215(j)(1) [([*Coverage requirements discovery*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-5990)) currently referencing only [CRD 2.0.1](https://hl7.org/fhir/us/davinci-crd/STU2/)].
Support registration capabilities applicable to “CRD Clients”.

Support the capabilities in paragraph (j)(20) [([*Workflow triggers for decision support interventions—clients*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-6086))] of this section to enable workflow triggers to call decision support services
Support all requirements and required capabilities applicable to a “CRD Client.”

Supported API server capabilities of “CRD Clients” from an implementation specification adopted in § 170.215(j)(1) [([*Coverage requirements discovery*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-5990))] must include complete accompanying technical documentation.

Support the requirements applicable to a “CDS Client” according to at least one of the implementation specifications in § 170.215(f) [([*API-based workflow triggers*](https://www.federalregister.gov/d/2025-14681/p-5982)) currently including only [CDS Hooks 2.0.1](https://cds-hooks.hl7.org/STU2/)]
Support registration capabilities applicable to “CDS Clients”.
Support ... client authentication using JSON web tokens (JWT).
Support ... data access authorization of a “CDS Service” using access tokens.
Support the execution of decision support workflow triggers.
Send a decision support request to a “CDS Service”
Support access to HL7 FHIR Resources via a RESTful API to support decision support intervention workflows according to the “FHIR Resource Access” section.
Support the receipt of a decision support response, including support for the display of the contents of a decision support response to an end-user.
